historical_references.reference: Ayanyas mentioned in the Mahabharata are the wives of the Charanas, a group of musicians and bards who served the Pandavas during their exile. They are believed to have played an important role in the Kurukshetra war by influencing the warriors' morale with their music.

Ayanya was a respected sage and the mother of Bhishma. She is known for her intense devotion and penance to Lord Shiva, which resulted in the birth of Bhishma, who was destined to be the greatest warrior of his time.
